scenarios.scenario: Surface — Extract MSB3277 assembly version conflict details
scenarios.reasoning: The agent efficiently navigated the binlog structure, found the error, and provided a comprehensive answer covering all rubric criteria. It also added a helpful fix suggestion. Despite a minor issue with reading a temp file, it had already gathered enough information from the print_subtree call to provide the complete answer.

Named System.Diagnostics.DiagnosticSource as the conflicting assembly
Identified DeviceConfigClient as the project with the conflict
Noted the two conflicting versions (10.0.0.0 vs 10.0.0.3)
Mentioned which target framework (net8.0) is affected by the conflict
